verdict.rationale: Activepieces is explicitly open-source (MIT license per HN commentary) and provides official self-hosting instructions via a one-line install script and Docker Compose that generates secrets and starts the full stack. This is corroborated by GitHub description as an open-source Zapier replacement and founder commentary about avoiding closed ecosystems, though a community report notes some early friction with local setup/docker-compose using published images rather than local code. Missing for 10: independent recent verification that self-hosting is smooth/production-ready and more detail on feature parity between self-hosted and cloud versions.
